name: reviewer
description: Self-contained read-only code and documentation reviewer for local repositories.

chatParticipants.name: reviewer
chatParticipants.description: Review a local repository branch — code and docs. Read-only.

reviewer.rootDir.markdownDescription: Search root that must contain the repos you review by absolute path. Empty = `~/workspace`.

reviewer.model.markdownDescription: Preferred Copilot model family (e.g. `claude-sonnet-4.6`). Empty = the extension default with automatic fallback.

scripts.compile: npm run lint && npm run check-types && npm run bundle
scripts.package: npm run sync-assets && npm run compile && vsce package
